parsed.rationale: The second participating record lives at `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift`, which sits inside an `Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/` directory — the canonical sample-app subtree. Even though `is_sample_app` is reported as `false`, the file path is authoritative: this is a demonstration copy of `DebugMetricsProvider.setUpDisplayLink` that mirrors the production implementation in `Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift`. Merging or extracting these two would couple the production `DebugPanel` package to sample-app semantics, which is the exact anti-pattern the restraint rule guards against. The correct resolution, if the sample-app copy is stale, is to delete it from the sample app — not to consolidate it with production code.
